Mr. Rakshit Shrivastava, learned counsel for the

Mr. Shubhang Dobhal, learned counsel for the respondents.
3. By means of this writ petition, petitioner has sought 
indulgence of this Court for quashing the rejection order 
dated 28.11.2020 (annexure no.6), passed by respondent 
no.2-Director as well as the order dated 15.05.2021 
(annexure no.14), passed by respondent no.3, whereby 
application of the petitioner for grant of secured family 
welfare allowance was rejected.
4. Learned counsel for the respondents prays for and is 
granted six weeks’ time for filing counter affidavit.
5. Two weeks’ time thereafter is granted to learned 
counsel for the petitioner for rejoinder affidavit.
6. List this case on 30.09.2024.
7. Defects as pointed out by the Registry have been 
removed by filing a fresh affidavit by the petitioner.
